intro: Panama has about 4.5 million people from many backgrounds.

chapters.title: People
text: Most Panamanians are of mixed descent; there are Afro-Panamanian communities and seven Indigenous peoples, including the Guna. Spanish is official.

chapters.title: Panama City
text: Panama City has a skyline of skyscrapers beside its old colonial quarter, Casco Viejo.

keyTerms.meaning: An Indigenous people known for mola textiles.
